name: MimartLabs
original_description: Connect your MimartLabs account to create and edit architectural projects through ChatGPT. Build rooms, walls, doors, windows, roofs and stairs; inspect geometry and model validation; change surface materials; and work with CAD drawings, layers and dimensions. Generate floor plans, sections and elevations, arrange drawing sheets, export DXF and reopen saved results in the Mimart editor. The connection operates on projects your account can access.

limitations_ja: MimartLabsアカウントの接続が必要。アクセス権のあるプロジェクトを操作する。
